repos_data.description: STPopup provides STPopupController, which works just like UINavigationController in popup style, for both iPhone and iPad. It's written in Objective-C and compatible with Swift.
Scrollable UINavigationBar that follows the scrolling of a UIScrollView
A framework for presenting view controllers as popups of other view controllers, much like the Apple Music and Podcasts apps.
Replicating the 'clear' navigation bar style of the iOS 12 Apple TV app.
A UINavigationController subclass that support pop interactive UINavigationbar with hidden or show.

A drop-in universal library helps you to manage the navigation bar styles and makes transition animations smooth between different navigation bar styles while pushing or popping a view controller for all orientations. And you don't need to write any line of code for it, it all happens automatically.
Dynamically changes status bar style depending on content behind it
Custom animation transition for present modal view controller
You can dismiss modal viewcontroller like Facebook Messenger by pulling scrollview or navigationbar in Swift.
ZoomTransitioning provides a custom transition with image zooming animation and swiping the screen edge.
Custom transition between viewcontrollers holding tableviews
Easily hide and show a view controller's navigation bar (and tab bar) as a user scrolls

repo_meta_data.description: A UINavigationController's category to enable fullscreen pop gesture with iOS7+ system style.
